question: Which operating system process takes care of starting the SAP HANA database system services? A. sapcontrol B. hdbdaemon C. sapstartsrv D. sapstart
Which compression algorithm is supported for SAP HANA system replication? A. GZIP B. LZ77 C. BZIP2 D. LZ4

You are running SAP HANA in a system replication setup. What happens to the tenant on the secondary site if the primary tenant is stopped? A. It is shut down. B. It performs a takeover. C. It is killed. D. It performs an initial data shipment.

What happens when you rename a tenant database in the SAP HANA cockpit? (Choose two.) A. The tenant database is stopped. B. The tenant database trace directory is renamed. C. The tenant database backups are renamed. D. The tenant database is unloaded from memory.
You want to prevent changes to system properties in tenant databases. Which configuration file stores the blocklisted properties? A. attributes.ini B. indexserver.ini C. multidb.ini D. global.ini

(Choose two.) A. CATALOG READ B. SELECT on the _SYS_TELEMETRY schema C. MONITOR ADMIN D. SELECT on the _SYS_STATISTICS schema
Which services are used between the SAP HANA cockpit and its managed resources? (Choose two.) A. sapstartsrv B. System Landscape Directory C. Diagnostics Agent D. Smart Data Streaming
